title: Tips to get more reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). Ask with a review link or QR code; incentives for reviews, changed reviews or removing negative reviews are strictly prohibited; reply tips: short, specific, conversational, not promotional, no deals; acknowledge mistakes, do not take blame for things outside your control, apologise where right, never share private information, move complex issues to phone or email.

title: Manage customer reviews (reply to reviews)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Only verified businesses can reply; every reply is checked against policy, usually within 10 minutes and sometimes up to 30 days; replies appear as the business; the reviewer is notified and can still change the review; replies can be edited or deleted.

title: Report inappropriate reviews on your Business Profile
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Only reviews that break policy are removed; Google does not remove negative or disputed reviews; evaluation typically takes several days; Reviews Management Tool shows status; one-time appeal of up to 10 reviews; automated spam detection can occasionally remove genuine reviews.

title: Review extortion scams (report a merchant extortion attempt)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Describes a burst of 1- and 2-star reviews followed by a demand for money; advises not to pay or engage, to collect evidence early, and to use the merchant extortion report form with screenshots, links and the extorter's contact details.

title: Business Profile restrictions for policy violations
supports: Opened with WebFetch. For fake engagement Google may block new reviews for a set period, unpublish existing reviews and show a warning that fake reviews were removed; owners are emailed first and can appeal.

title: Prohibited & restricted content (fake engagement), Maps user contributed content policy
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Fake engagement removed; incentivised reviews, including incentives to revise or remove; conflicts of interest (current or former staff, contractors, family, competitors); merchants must not discourage negative reviews, selectively solicit positive ones, pressure customers on the premises, or set staff quotas or required content such as staff names; enforcement up to account termination.

title: Report Content for Legal Reasons
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Flag content in the product first; otherwise create a legal request per product with exact URLs and a specific explanation; removal applies only to Google products; copyright goes through the separate DMCA process.

title: Guidelines for Businesses (version 7.3, September 2026)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (legal.trustpilot.com redirects here). Invite all genuine customers consistently, one invitation per experience; no selective inviting or pre-screening; no incentives for leaving or editing reviews; replies polite, no personal information; flag grounds (harmful or illegal incl. defamation, personal information, promotional or AI-generated misinformation, not a genuine experience, wrong business); disagreement is not a valid flag; consequences include a Consumer Warning and a hidden TrustScore.

title: Don't Ask for Reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). Businesses should not ask anyone for Yelp reviews; no staff competitions; no incentives, including to remove reviews; recommendation software may not recommend solicited reviews; Consumer Alerts for incentive activity.

title: When should I report a review?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Removal grounds: conflicts of interest, irrelevant or not first-hand content, threats, harassment, hate speech and lewd comments, private information; suspicion alone is not enough and reports need specific evidence; strong language is allowed.

title: Yelp Trust & Safety Report 2025
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Calendar year 2025: 22 million reviews contributed; 46,200+ reviews with inappropriate content removed; 491 Compensated Activity and Suspicious Review Activity alerts; nearly 500,000 suspected AI-generated reviews filtered out; 6 Questionable Legal Threat alerts.

title: Reviews (Community Standards and Guidelines)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no effective date shown). Anyone affiliated may not review; incentives prohibited regardless of rating, including donations and staff bonuses; selective solicitation prohibited and survey routes must be identical for positive and negative experiences; no coercion; staff may not write, watch or suggest wording; contracts discouraging negative reviews bring a warning badge; penalties include ranking penalties and red badges; reviews within one year of the experience.

title: Management Responses (Community Standards and Guidelines)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Responses must not speculate about a reviewer's identity, include personal information, threaten or coerce, promote or offer gifts or money, quote correspondence, accuse reviewers of review fraud, or use lists or bullets.

title: Content & Community Guidelines
supports: Opened with WebFetch. AI-generated review content is not permitted; management responses are removed if they identify a reviewer or guests with information not already in the review; 4.2 million reviews moderated in 2025.

title: What to Do if You Receive a Negative Review
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). Message the buyer first; one public response per review within 100 days of the buyer's last edit; a public response stops the buyer editing the review; no tracking numbers, links or private information; Etsy removes only policy-breaking reviews and will not judge accuracy.

title: View and reply to reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch. One public reply per review, editable; the user gets a push notification and email; users can update their rating any time; replies must not solicit or promote; suggested replies for recent English reviews; new reviews are generally held about 24 hours.

title: Federal Trade Commission Announces Final Rule Banning Fake Reviews and Testimonials (14 August 2024)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The six prohibitions, including AI-generated fake reviews, sentiment-conditioned incentives, undisclosed insider reviews, company-controlled review sites, review suppression by threats or false claims that shown reviews are all reviews, and fake social media indicators; civil penalties for knowing violations.

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rule in effect 21 October 2024; review management companies can be liable; businesses may ask all customers, contact customers to resolve complaints and ask satisfied customers to update reviews; may reply publicly but not make knowingly false accusations; no groundless legal threats; staff guidance with no safe harbour.

title: Soliciting and Paying for Online Reviews: A Guide for Marketers (January 2022)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Do not ask only customers likely to be positive; ask only real customers; disclose incentives; staff and family disclose their connection; check each platform's rules; do not misuse platform reporting tools against honest negative reviews.

title: Consumer Review Fairness Act: What Businesses Need to Know
supports: Opened with WebFetch (page dated February 2017). Form-contract clauses that bar reviews, fine reviewers or take their rights in review content are illegal; businesses may still remove reviews with confidential information, libel, harassment, obscenity, unrelated content or clearly false content; a disliked opinion is unlikely to count.

title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Customer comments may be used in ads if they reflect honest opinion; disclose if customers were told they might appear in an ad; disclose incentives; typical-results disclosure for exceptional results; sending review requests only to likely-happy customers misleads if it substantially skews ratings; Guides revised in 2023.

title: Fashion Nova Will Pay $4.2 Million as Part of Settlement of FTC Allegations it Blocked Negative Reviews (25 January 2022)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A review interface auto-posted 4- and 5-star reviews and held lower ones, never posted from late 2015 to November 2019 (hundreds of thousands); $4.2 million; warning letters to 10 review management companies.

title: Fake reviews: short guide for businesses publishing consumer reviews (4 April 2025)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Banned: fake reviews, concealed incentivised reviews, false or misleading review information including ratings built on fake reviews, writing or commissioning fake reviews; businesses that publish reviews take reasonable and proportionate steps, publish a review policy, assess risk and run checks. The full CMA208 PDF was fetched but could not be read as text.

title: CMA to boost consumer and business confidence as new consumer protection regime comes into force (7 April 2025)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. DMCC Act consumer provisions now in force; CMA can decide breaches itself and fine up to 10% of global turnover; explicit ban on posting and commissioning fake reviews; fake reviews a first-year focus.

title: CMA secures important changes from Google to tackle fake reviews (24 January 2025)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. UK businesses that boost ratings with fake reviews get a warning alert and reviews switched off; repeat offenders have reviews deleted for 6 months or more; rogue reviewers banned; consumer reporting for incentivised reviews; Google reports to the CMA for 3 years.

title: Unfair commercial practices (consumer reviews section)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (page last checked 28/04/2026). Traders that publish reviews must say how they make sure reviews come from real consumers; altering reviews and paying for fake reviews or likes are banned.

title: Testimonials and endorsements (advice online, 21 September 2026)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. CAP Code 3.47 documentary evidence that a testimonial is genuine plus contact details; 3.48 relates to the product and is not edited misleadingly; 3.49 claims in testimonials must not mislead; 3.50 permission needed; 2.3 marketers must not pose as consumers.

title: Process personal data lawfully (SME data protection guide)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Six lawful bases; valid consent is freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous, as easy to withdraw as to give, and recorded; health and other sensitive data face extra limits.

title: Fake It Till You Make It: Reputation, Competition, and Yelp Review Fraud (Michael Luca and Georgios Zervas, HBS Working Paper 14-006, 2013, revised 2015)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (abstract only; hbs.edu blocked fetching). About 16% of Yelp restaurant reviews are filtered as suspicious; restaurants with few or recent bad reviews are more likely to commit review fraud; chains less likely; more competition brings more unfavourable fake reviews.

title: How Online Reviews Influence Sales (page dated 4 December 2025; findings first published 2017)
publisher: Medill Spiegel Research Center, Northwestern University
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A product with five reviews had a 270% higher purchase likelihood than one with none, with fast-falling gains after that; purchase likelihood peaked at ratings of 4.0 to 4.7; a verified buyer badge raised purchase odds by 15%.
